scope: Dense combat optimization; retain existing visual quality, gameplay rates and generated assets.
limitations: Extreme fixed-tick pressure remains above the 16.67 ms frame budget.
Final native real-delta battle: mean 15.06 ms, p95 21.37 ms, 75.70% of frames <=16.67 ms; no significant whole-battle improvement demonstrated.
Natural real-delta runs evolve into different battles and cannot establish strict deterministic A/B speedup.

Fixed-tick pressure results also vary slightly in final projectile count and damage, including repeated identical modes. Comparable actor/part/projectile loads, not exact-frame deterministic evidence.
Native renderer ran in offscreen windows on this machine. Foreground, hardware and driver behavior can differ.
Phase instrumentation adds overhead; release main_draw is a sum of existing main draw phase timers, excluding some child canvas work.
Earlier four-run pressure comparison preceded adaptive muzzle/hull thresholds and the compact-anatomy parking delay. Final two-run comparison uses the delivered executable.

implementation.hostile_projectile_commands: Exact native commands retained per stable visual ID; shared material; transforms/visibility only; retired pool <=96.
implementation.muzzle_batch: Same five tongues, halo, pigment, fade and husk in shared GPU instances. Visible muzzle threshold 12; sparse and capacity fallback use original draw path.
implementation.player_hull_index: Only when >4 parts and >=3 incoming hostile projectiles; ordered broadphase, original narrowphase and live HP/cloak checks.
implementation.equipment: Frame-local shield indices; skip chip adjacency only when no chip core exists in that support tick.
implementation.shield_targets: Original ranking and tie order before cave raycasts; random radar retains original path.
implementation.rigs: Deduplicate unchanged properties; park hidden full anatomy after 0.2 s stable existing compact view; immediate restore for full detail and death.
